description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy values for two tweet-related categories using three sentiment analysis approaches. The horizontal axis contains two grouped categories labeled “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” and the x-axis title reads “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks shown at regular 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each category contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend entries: TEXTBLOB (white bar with black outline), VADER (white bar with diagonal hatch and black outline), and ChatGPT (solid green). For “Emoji Tweets,” the TEXTBLOB bar reaches approximately 0.33, the VADER hatched bar reaches about 0.45, and the green ChatGPT bar reaches about 0.67. For “Overall Tweet,” the TEXTBLOB bar is approximately 0.40, the VADER hatched bar is about 0.47, and the green ChatGPT bar is about 0.66. The bars are arranged in side-by-side groups rather than stacked, there is no visible sorting beyond the left-to-right category order, and no individual bars appear specially annotated or emphasized beyond the distinct fill styles and the legend.
